method: Dated editorial form and race-shape assessment. Form, barrier, carried weight, class, distance and public stable or jockey reports are considered. Observed market prices informed comparisons but are not republished as live quotes. These selections are not calibrated model probabilities.

_tips.title: Cashout's Sydney preparation
_tips.detail: The co-trainer reported Cashout had settled into a Sydney base after more than ten days and expected his forward running style to help. The latest Soft 6 board adds a ground question: his published Soft sample is limited.

_tips.title: Wet ground changes the juvenile call
_tips.detail: Public stable comments say Proverb disliked very heavy ground and improved in a dry-track trial. Racing NSW says Silent Intent handled the heavy debut better; on the latest Soft 6 board she is the condition-led choice, with only one race run to assess.

_tips.title: Berry on Lazzura and Declichy Boulevard
_tips.detail: Jockey Tommy Berry highlighted Lazzura's low draw and weight, and said Declichy Boulevard should appreciate give in the ground. Both comments are public pre-race views, not a guarantee of the running.

_tips.title: Welcometotheshow has a weight swing
_tips.detail: Trainer comments describe a luckless Prelude run; Welcometotheshow meets Declichy Boulevard 2 kg better. The 1800 m distance remains an untested part of that comparison.

_tips.title: Horseshoe Hill steps up in trip
_tips.detail: The Baker stable's racing manager said 1000 m was too short first-up and expects the 1200 m and gate two to suit a run just behind the pace. Verify current scratchings and conditions.

_weather.status: Public track sources disagree: the Racing and Sports race-day field displays Soft 6, while Racing NSW acceptances still list Good 4. Recheck the official current rating and scratchings before relying on any later-race selection.
_weather.if_soft: The original selections have not been recalculated for Soft 6. Give more weight to verified wet-track form and race-day pattern before using them.

6.revision_note: Rosehill R6 selection revised before the scheduled jump for a Soft-track scenario. Public rating sources disagree; confirm the official current rating before relying on either runner.
6.weather_scenario: If the official rating is Soft 6, Silent Intent has the better direct wet debut; if Good 4 remains, Proverb’s dry-track trial case strengthens. Neither is a calibrated probability.

reasons: Racing NSW's race preview says her Heavy 10 debut was better than Proverb's under those conditions, and she has trialled well since.
Barrier three and a 56.5 kg carried weight give her a practical setup over 1100 m if the Soft 6 rating persists.
primary.risk: One race start is thin evidence, and Heavy 10 form does not precisely predict Soft 6 performance.

reasons: The stable reported improvement in a trial after his debut on extremely heavy ground.

_tips.title: Tempted's preparation and straight-track test
_tips.detail: Ciaron Maher reported Tempted had travelled and worked well into the sprint. Her first run up Flemington's straight remains a genuine unknown, even though published Soft-track form is strong.

_tips.title: Joliestar's course experience
_tips.detail: The VRC preview contrasts Tempted's Flemington debut with Joliestar's proven straight-track record. Check the official ground rating and early straight races before weighting this factor.

_tips.title: Autumn Glow's first left-handed race
_tips.detail: Chris Waller was pleased with Autumn Glow's Flemington gallop, but the race is her first left-handed start. The course switch is a real test despite her strong wet-track record.

_tips.title: Tom Kitten receives blinkers
_tips.detail: The stable is trying first-time blinkers with Tom Kitten and prefers the mile to 2000 m. His limited Soft-track winning form still matters if the rain affects the surface.

_tips.title: Champions Stakes form angles
_tips.detail: The VRC preview notes Cosmic Crusader's two wins from two Flemington 2000 m runs, Birdman's interrupted Cox Plate passage, and Aeliana's draw at 57 kg. These are competing form angles, not inside information.

_weather.status: Rain reported at or near Flemington; the latest independently checked race board still showed Good 4 and rail +9 m. Do not treat a forecast or shower as an official track downgrade.
_weather.if_soft: If the official rating moves to Soft, reassess each runner's actual soft-ground record and watch whether early straight races favour a particular lane. The current selections are conditional on the noted Good 4 snapshot.

1.track: Good 4 at research snapshot; recheck if rain arrives
1.weather_scenario: Two-year-old wet-track evidence is thin. If rain changes the rating, reduce confidence in both runners and use the opening straight race to assess which part of the course is quickest.

reasons: A race win provides firmer evidence than trials alone in this two-year-old field.
Blake Shinn rides; the wide straight-course draw is a smaller concern than a sharp-turn sprint draw.
primary.risk: Only one race start; two-year-old improvement is highly variable.

reasons: Debut third gives race experience and a demonstrated finish.
Equal assigned weight to Soldi keeps the comparison focused on ability and track position.
alternative.risk: Inside stall may be the wrong part of the straight if the field shifts outward.

2.track: Good 4 at research snapshot; recheck if rain arrives
2.weather_scenario: If the surface turns Soft, the six-kilogram weight gap remains but today's dry-form comparison becomes less certain. Keep Fiorenot and Superfabulistic in the same order until a verified wet-ground record or early-race bias supports a change.

reasons: A win followed by a second supports current mile fitness.
Barrier four offers an economical route in a 1600 m handicap; VRC's published analyst also highlighted this runner.
primary.risk: Carries 6 kg more than the alternative, so a tough pace may narrow the edge.

reasons: Five consecutive top-three form figures and a six-kilogram weight advantage make the place case strong.
Barrier two suits a forward-running map.
alternative.risk: Needs to handle the step up to this benchmark grade.

3.track: Good 4 at research snapshot; recheck if rain arrives
3.weather_scenario: Rain over 2600 m can make stamina more important. Pinhole's 3.5 kg advantage over Defiantly remains, but no verified wet-ground comparison here justifies changing the order solely because showers arrive.

reasons: The five starts before the latest run contained three wins and two placings.
VRC described his Moonee Valley Cup run as luckless; 56 kg is 3.5 kg less than Defiantly carries.
primary.risk: The 2600 m staying test and last-start seventh leave some uncertainty.

reasons: Two latest wins and proven European staying class make him a credible challenger.
A wide gate matters less over 2600 m if the jockey can find cover.
alternative.risk: Australian debut and top weight are real unknowns.

public_news.text: VRC reported Defiantly's French Group 2 win and described Pinhole's Moonee Valley Cup defeat as luckless.

4.track: Good 4 at research snapshot; recheck if rain arrives
4.weather_scenario: At 1200 m down the straight, rain can shift the preferred lane. Recheck the official rating and the earlier straight-race run before using barrier 11 versus 17 as a tiebreak.

reasons: A fresh win supplies current ability evidence at a light 54 kg.
A public form preview regarded the second-up run as luckless, supporting a rebound scenario.
primary.risk: Barrier 11 and a busy straight-course field create traffic risk.

reasons: Four successive top-four results support a place rather than all-or-nothing win view.
Public preview notes prior straight-track experience.
alternative.risk: The outside gate and lack of a recent win make the place case sensitive to track bias.

public_news.text: The public TABtouch preview describes Hankee Alpha's second-up run as luckless and Inkaruna as straight-track tested.

5.track: Good 4 at research snapshot; recheck if rain arrives
5.weather_scenario: A softer 2000 m would put more weight on proven stamina. Soverato has the stronger recent near-distance result; Vivy Air's untried 2000 m becomes a bigger uncertainty if the ground deteriorates.

reasons: The latest win at a near-identical trip is stronger direct distance evidence than several rivals have.
Barrier two and Damian Lane offer an economical map at 2000 m.
primary.risk: Steps into a stronger Group 2 field with the same 57 kg as other leading mares.

reasons: Carries 2 kg less than Soverato and draws the rail.
Strong Sydney-class form makes her a plausible top-three runner if she relaxes at the longer trip.
alternative.risk: The 2000 m distance is unproven in the public preview.

public_news.text: The HKJC public preview notes Soverato's recent Flemington 2040 m win and flags Vivy Air's untested 2000 m trip.

6.track: Good 4 at research snapshot; recheck if rain arrives
6.weather_scenario: If the rating becomes Soft, retain Tempted as the win selection: published form lists five wins from five Soft starts, including the Soft 5 Everest where she beat Joliestar, and a Soft 6 Premiere Stakes win. Joliestar also handles rain-affected ground and was third in that Everest, so she remains the other win/place candidate. Tempted has no Heavy-track race and no Flemington straight start; do not extrapolate the Soft record to Heavy.

reasons: The published career, distance and Soft-track strike rates are the strongest numerical form case in the sprint.
She won the Soft 5 Everest over Joliestar and the Soft 6 Premiere Stakes; the stable also reported she travelled and worked well.
primary.risk: First race down the Flemington straight and no Heavy-track start; an actual downgrade or lane bias must be checked.

reasons: Multiple wins at the trip and Soft-track placings support a challenge at equal weight.
Prior Flemington straight experience includes a placing on Heavy ground, unlike Tempted's untested Heavy record.
alternative.risk: Tempted beat her in the Soft 5 Everest and her recent winning run sets a high bar.

public_news.text: The Tempted stable publicly reported satisfactory travel and a Flemington gallop; this is public information, not private stable access.

7.track: Good 4 at research snapshot; recheck if rain arrives
7.weather_scenario: If the official rating turns Soft, Autumn Glow's case strengthens: her published record is seven wins from seven Soft starts and one from one Heavy. Tom Kitten has one win and one third from eight Soft starts, so his place case weakens relative to her. Keep the same two names, but lower confidence in the alternative; this remains Autumn Glow's first Flemington start.

reasons: An exceptional 14-from-15 record and unbeaten mile record dominate the published form comparison.
Draw two and a 2 kg weight advantage over male rivals support a favourable trip; the Soft record also supports a rain scenario.
primary.risk: First Melbourne and left-handed race; her odds may offer little value despite a strong chance.

metrics: Two wins / three Flemington mile starts
reasons: Course-and-distance record supports a place chance in this exact setting.
A public stable report says first-time blinkers are intended to sharpen him.
alternative.risk: A Soft downgrade weakens this case: one win and one third from eight Soft starts.

public_news.text: VRC reported a satisfactory local gallop for Autumn Glow and first-time blinkers for Tom Kitten.

8.track: Good 4 at research snapshot; recheck if rain arrives
8.weather_scenario: If the official rating becomes Soft, retain Cosmic Crusader as the win selection: five wins from six Soft starts and a Heavy 8 Turnbull Stakes win at Flemington over 2000 m support him. Birdman has two wins from five Soft starts, but Aeliana's four wins from six Soft starts make her a stronger conditional place alternative on genuinely Soft ground. Recheck official scratchings and the final rating before switching the second selection.

reasons: Cox Plate and Turnbull Stakes wins give the strongest recent Group 1 performance case.
The published Flemington record is unbeaten, including a Heavy 8 Turnbull win at 2000 m.
primary.risk: Barrier 11 and a rival drawn inside could make the early map more costly.

metrics: Five top-three finishes / six at 2000 m
reasons: Second in the Cox Plate after traffic trouble suggests he can close the gap to Cosmic Crusader with a cleaner passage.
Barrier one saves ground if he avoids being pocketed.
alternative.risk: The same inside stall could trap him behind tiring horses; Aeliana is another major threat.

public_news.text: VRC's public preview describes Birdman's held-up Cox Plate run and Cosmic Crusader's recent Group 1 wins.
